'''Utility blades''' were emergency equipment used in survival situations. They were issued to [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to help them cut through dense foliage in [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] in the event of a crash-landing.<ref name="IHB">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=Into the Heat of Battle}}</ref>
